scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for all n>=2; finite standard-library exact-integer checks corroborate only. Original polytope definition and prior radial shell are credited.
scientific_limitations: Ambient Euclidean metric in the standard harmonic-polytope realization; not affine invariant and not a complete pairwise-distance distribution. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The exact Euclidean diameter and sparse diametral matching of the harmonic polytope
